title: Successful Login
steps:
Enter valid email and password
Click 'Login'
expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to the dashboard.

title: Login with Invalid Password
expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating invalid password.

title: Login with Missing Email
expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating missing email.

title: Login with Email and Password
steps:
Enter valid email and password
Click 'Login'
expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to the dashboard.

Click 'Reset Password'
Follow reset instructions
expected_result: Password reset process initiated and user redirected to the dashboard.
